description: This file defines the internal class ImplicitStreamSubscriberTable, which manages implicit stream subscriptions within the Orleans streaming framework. It includes methods for building and caching subscription data, retrieving implicit subscribers, and generating unique subscription GUIDs based on grain and stream identifiers.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriberTable
classes.description: Manages implicit stream subscriptions, including building, caching, and retrieving subscribers based on stream IDs and grain types.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriberTable.Cache
classes.description: Holds cached subscription data, including version, predicates, and namespace mappings.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriberTable.StreamSubscriberPredicate
classes.description: Associates a stream subscriber with a namespace predicate for filtering.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriberTable.StreamSubscriber
classes.description: Represents a subscriber with grain bindings and a stream ID mapper, capable of generating grain IDs for subscriptions.

methods.name: GetCache
methods.description: Retrieves the current cache, rebuilding it if the bindings have changed.

methods.name: BuildCache
methods.description: Constructs a new cache of subscription predicates and namespace mappings based on current bindings.

methods.name: GetImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of implicit subscriber GUIDs to GrainIds for a given stream ID.

methods.name: GetOrAddImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the set of implicit subscribers for a given namespace.

methods.name: IsImplicitSubscriber
methods.description: Checks if a given grain ID is an implicit subscriber of a specific stream.

methods.name: TryGetImplicitSubscriptionGuid
methods.description: Attempts to get a unique subscription GUID for a grain and stream, if it is an implicit subscriber.

methods.name: MakeSubscriptionGuid
methods.description: Creates a unique GUID for a subscription based on grain type and stream ID.

methods.name: IsImplicitSubscribeEligibleNameSpace
methods.description: Determines if a namespace is eligible for implicit subscription.

methods.name: FindImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Finds all subscribers matching a namespace predicate.
